mapper.sql: s.id, s.student_no, s.name, s.gender, s.college, s.major, s.class_name, s.grade, s.dorm_building, s.dorm_room, s.phone, s.id_card, s.native_place, s.political_status, s.counselor_id, s.status, s.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.counselor_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
SELECT , u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.counselor_id = u.id WHERE s.student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (student_no, name, gender, college, major, class_name, grade, dorm_building, dorm_room, phone, id_card, native_place, political_status, counselor_id, status) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{dormBuilding}, #{dormRoom}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{nativePlace}, #{politicalStatus}, #{counselorId}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE student
student_no = #{studentNo}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, college = #{college}, major = #{major}, class_name = #{className}, grade = #{grade}, dorm_building = #{dormBuilding}, dorm_room = #{dormRoom}, phone = #{phone}, id_card = #{idCard}, native_place = #{nativePlace}, political_status = #{politicalStatus}, counselor_id = #{counselorId}, status = #{status},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE student SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT college AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM student WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY college ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT gender AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM student WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY gender
SELECT political_status AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM student WHERE deleted = 0 AND political_status IS NOT NULL AND political_status != '' GROUP BY political_status ORDER BY value DESC
